description: Inferred market ASKING-rate range ($/m²/yr) for self-storage by size band and location: a plain median of asking $/m²/yr from public advertised standard rates, promo-haircut 0.95 (floor). States radius_facility_count and nearest_priced_facility_km; when fewer than 8 comparable facilities sit inside the radius the headline falls back to the state pool and is flagged (fallback, headline_is_fallback, confidence='insufficient') — not a local rate. A market screen — not achieved rent, occupancy, or valuation.

lat.description: Latitude of the location to query (required). Decimal degrees inside Australia, e.g. -33.796.

lng.description: Longitude of the location to query (required). Decimal degrees inside Australia, e.g. 151.183.

radius_km.description: Radius to search for comparable facilities in kilometres (default 5). Must be greater than 0. A value below 1 is clamped to 1 and a value above 50 is clamped to 50, never rejected: radius_applied_km states the radius that ran and radius_note says when it was clamped.

size_bracket.description: Storage unit size bracket (required). One of: locker, small, medium, large, extra_large, garage_plus, vehicle.

name: inferred_market_rate
